subject: gk
question: WTO was formed in the year 1995 to replace which of the following institutions?

options.text: Industrial Board of Reconstruction and Development
General Agreement of Trade and Tariff

solution:
The correct answer is __**General Agreement of Trade and Tariff**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) was established on **1 January 1995**, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT).
 
• GATT was created in **1948** as a legal agreement between multiple nations to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs or quotas.
 
• WTO expanded the scope of GATT by incorporating agreements on services (GATS) and intellectual property (TRIPS).
 
• The WTO serves as a forum for trade negotiations, dispute resolution, and enforcement of trade agreements among member countries.
 
• As of 2023, the WTO has **164 member countries**, accounting for over 98% of global trade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions of WTO:**

 
 
• Administers trade agreements and ensures their implementation by member countries.
 
• Provides a platform for trade negotiations to enhance global trade liberalization.
 
• Resolves trade disputes between member nations through its dispute settlement mechanism.
 
• Monitors global trade policies and provides technical assistance to developing countries.
 
 
 
• **GATT Overview:**
 
 
• GATT was a multilateral agreement aimed at promoting international trade by reducing tariffs and other trade barriers.
 
• It underwent eight rounds of negotiations, with the last being the Uruguay Round (1986–1994), which led to the creation of the WTO.
 
• GATT primarily dealt with trade in goods, whereas the WTO expanded its scope to include services and intellectual property.
 
 
 
• **Key Agreements under WTO:**
 
 
• **GATS:** General Agreement on Trade in Services focuses on trade in services.
 
• **TRIPS:** Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights sets minimum standards for intellectual property regulation.
 
• **Agreement on Agriculture (AoA):** Addresses agricultural trade policies including subsidies, market access, and export competition.
 
 
 
• **Criticism of WTO:**
 
 
• Accused of favoring developed countries at the expense of developing nations.
 
• Critics argue that its policies promote corporate interests over environmental and labor rights.
 
• Decision-making is often criticized for being non-inclusive, with smaller economies having limited influence.
